name: Urara in Satsuki
source:
On an exceptionally hot evening early in May, a young woman came out of the garret in which she lodged in S. Place and walked slowly, as though in hesitation, towards K. bridge.

Past the bridge, she makes the mistake of returning to Satsuki, a woman she loathes and worships. It's just that sort of day.

The world is bright with all sorts of colours. And again, she will be remade as God.

[From [url=https://kirinkoumori.itch.io/uds]itch.io[/url]]
